title: Maintenance of rstudio-desktop-bin package
body: The rstudio-desktop-bin package has been partially broken and frequently very outdated for going on 2 years now. A community member, cbrnr, has been extremely helpful about providing complete and up-to-date PKGBUILDs. The current maintainer, Meow, ignores AUR comments and refuses to work with the community or step down. Meow updates the package just enough to avoid letting it be marked as orphaned. Is there a process for dealing with this? From a user perspective, it's incredibly frustrating. (Also, apologies and please redirect me if I'm posting this in the wrong subforum!)
